title: Add Mood-Based Music feature that plays latest tracks by mood

requirements.text: Add a new "Mood Music" section to the React app that lets the user pick a mood and then browse and play a list of music tracks for that mood, with an explicit option to view/play the latest tracks first.

quotes: create Mood Based Music  app play music  lates

acceptanceCriteria: The app UI includes a clearly labeled entry point for "Mood Music" (e.g., a new tab alongside existing tabs).
The user can select a mood (at minimum: Happy, Calm, Sad, Energetic) and see a track list update based on the selected mood.
The user can play/pause a selected track using standard in-browser audio playback controls.
A "Latest" mode exists that sorts/shows tracks with newest first (based on track metadata provided by the app).
All user-facing text in this feature is in English.

requirements.text: Bundle a small, local music catalog in the frontend (no external streaming) and use it as the source for mood-based playback, including metadata needed to support a "Latest" sort (e.g., release date or added date).

quotes: create Mood Based Music  app play music  lates

acceptanceCriteria: At least 8 sample tracks are available across the moods (can be shared across moods), stored as static assets under the frontend public directory (e.g., frontend/public/assets/music).
Each track displayed in the UI includes at minimum: title, artist (or "Unknown Artist"), mood tags, and a date field used for "Latest" ordering.
No third-party music APIs are required for the feature to function.

requirements.text: Update the app header branding and labels to reflect the Mood Based Music experience (while keeping existing authentication/profile flows intact).

quotes: create Mood Based Music  app play music  lates

acceptanceCriteria: The app title and subtitle shown in the header are updated to match the mood-based music focus (English text).
Internet Identity login/logout still works via the existing LoginButton, without modifying any immutable hook files.
If the user is authenticated and has a profile, the header still greets the user by name as it does today.

requirements.text: Ensure the Mood Music UI uses the existing Tailwind/Shadcn design system and is consistent with the current theme variables (avoid introducing blue/purple as primary brand colors).

quotes: create Mood Based Music  app play music  lates

acceptanceCriteria: Mood Music components use existing Shadcn UI components (e.g., Card, Button, Tabs) and existing theme tokens from CSS variables.
No new primary branding is introduced that relies on blue/purple as the dominant color.

requirements.text: Add a short in-app info notice specific to Mood Music clarifying that music playback uses bundled/local audio files (not external music services), keeping all copy in English.

quotes: create Mood Based Music  app play music  lates

acceptanceCriteria: The Mood Music section includes an English info note stating that playback is from app-bundled audio files and does not use external streaming services.
The existing speech InfoNotice remains accurate and is not removed (it may be repositioned if needed).

requirements.text: Render newly generated mood icon images as static assets and use them in the Mood Music UI (e.g., on mood selector cards/buttons).

quotes: create Mood Based Music  app play music  lates

acceptanceCriteria: All images listed in imageRequirements.required are checked into frontend/public/assets/generated.
Mood selection UI visually displays the corresponding mood icon next to the mood label.
Icons render crisply on common screen densities and do not appear stretched (correct aspect ratio preserved).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any sources under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if state schema changes are required.
All user-facing copy must be in English.
nonGoals: Integrating with external music streaming providers (Spotify/Apple Music/YouTube) or requiring external music APIs.
Implementing real-time features (e.g., shared listening sessions, chat, WebSockets).
Implementing paid subscriptions or payments for music content.

required: Flat vector mood icon: happy face with sun motif, warm colors (mood-happy.dim_256x256.png)
Flat vector mood icon: calm face with crescent moon/cloud motif, soft neutral/teal colors (mood-calm.dim_256x256.png)
Flat vector mood icon: sad face with raindrop motif, muted colors (mood-sad.dim_256x256.png)
Flat vector mood icon: energetic face with lightning motif, bold warm colors (mood-energetic.dim_256x256.png)
